deviceDiscovery._comment: Silent background sweep binds Alexa skill deviceIds to hardware serials. POST /api/devices/discover?force=1 to run immediately.

claude._comment: Optional. Powers Mix Muse conversational playlists.

openai._comment: Optional. Alternative LLM provider for Mix Muse.

alexaRemote._comment: Optional. Unofficial Alexa API for Play on device. url = amazon.com | amazon.co.uk | etc. Prefer env vars ALEXA_REMOTE_EMAIL, ALEXA_REMOTE_PASSWORD, ALEXA_REMOTE_OTP_SECRET, ALEXA_REMOTE_URL over on-disk secrets.

alexaAplLyrics._comment: Echo Show synced lyrics via APL. See docs/ECHO_SHOW_APL_LYRICS.md. Enable on NAS after skill manifest update.

mobileApi._comment: Bearer token for mobile apps and external API access.

appDownload._comment: Basic auth for GET /app (APK/IPA downloads). Falls back to WebPassword if omitted.
